name: conti_long_x020

source.title: Ex-Market Maker Shows the Exact VWAP Setup That Gets Traders Funded

entry.words: Long when the 15-minute trend is true -- the close is above the VWAP anchored at the 09:30 open, the VWAP is higher than 15 minutes ago, and the price is up at least 0.1 % over the last hour -- and a red candle (the pullback) comes: enter at the next bar's open by market order.

taught: [notes section 2; screen [14:18]-[15:20]] LONG trend = the close above VWAP, VWAP higher than 15 minutes ago, price up at least 0.1 % over the last hour (4 bars of 15 minutes); VWAP anchored at the 09:30 ET cash open
[notes section 2; screen [24:26]-[25:26]] trigger: the first red candle (a pullback) once the trend is true; the distance to VWAP does not matter; entry at the next bar open by market order
[notes section 2] no trades 09:30-10:30 ET, no new trades after 15:30 ET, everything flat at 15:55 ET
[notes section 2] long: stop 80 points, target 40 points

[notes section 2] one position at a time, at most 4 trades a day, stop for the day after 2 losing trades IN A ROW ([22:01] 'if you have two consecutive trades that are losing trades for the day, we stop trading it'; owner 2026-10-10: 2 in a row)
[notes section 2] the 0.1 % threshold and the cap of 4 trades were tuned in sample (his words): the lane runs them as he gives them, untuned
[owner 2026-10-11, pre-registered] one setting moved from the video's value: x = 0.2 (plateau check, long only, 5-minute bars)
not_run: The trigger candle is read on the bar size of the run (1, 5 and 15 minutes: the owner asked for all three; the video loads the 5-minute and the 15-minute chart). The state is read on that same bar's close, not on a separate 15-minute chart: on 5-minute bars the 'VWAP higher than 15 minutes ago' is exact; on 1- and 15-minute bars it is the same 15 minutes read on that bar's closes.

'First red candle once the trend is true': the first down bar after a bar that was not down, while the state holds (a new pullback; it can fire again later the same day within the cap). The video does not say first after what.
The VWAP is the family's own: volume-weighted typical price (high + low + close) / 3 of the 1-minute bars from 09:30; the video does not say which price or which bars.
Flat time: the engine flattens at 15:58 ET (13:13 on half days); the video says 15:55.
Costs and the order of a stop and a target inside one bar: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage, $4 a round turn, tick replay); the video says nothing.
The random control and the reads go pass by pass (nyam, mid, pm), matched by day: the random entries do not wait for the 10:30-15:30 window or share the day cap.
